title: Chinese Learning Database
purpose: Knowledge map for individualized Chinese learning and progress tracking. This project is initialized before any learner-specific quiz banks are created.
important_limitations: This database tracks structure and progression, not learner performance data.
No test-bank question files are linked yet. The project is currently not populated.
Future branches can be personalized by learner (for example Y, A, F, J) and content skill area.

taxonomy.name: Chinese Learning Path
taxonomy.description: Main learning framework for Chinese language progression and skill building.
